children: Mag Magna Corp reported fiscal 2026 results in its 10-K, recording zero revenue, a net loss of ($14.72M) for the year and diluted earnings per share of ($1.85), versus a net loss of ($52.25K) and EPS of ($0.01) in fiscal 2025.
¹ Reported as “Total Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net Loss Before Provision for Income Taxes”. ³ Reported as “Other Income (Expense)”.
In January 2026 the company pivoted from poultry-farming consulting to rare earth mineral exploration and began acquiring mining rights.
Mag Magna recorded acquisitions of mineral rights covering 21 parcels in Illinois and 3 lode claims in Arizona, issuing equity as consideration.
The company discontinued prior consulting/API revenue streams; future revenue is expected to depend on successful exploration and development of mining properties.
Committed minimum work programs and property payments include at least $100K in 2026 and $200K in 2027 to advance exploration activities.
